name: gods-eye-view
description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
one_liner: A browser globe that shows real, live flights, ships, fires, and weather happening right now, and lets you click any of them to zoom in and watch.
buyer: A news or explainer YouTuber who needs real-looking footage of a breaking event (a wildfire, a diverted flight, a ship in distress) without a camera crew on site.
business_use_cases: A news/explainer YouTuber uses it to film a live 'tracking shot' of a real wildfire, flight, or ship for a breaking-news video instead of licensing stock footage.
A logistics or insurance company uses the live aircraft/ship tracking as a cheap situational-awareness dashboard for monitoring assets in transit.
An events or travel brand uses the cinematic globe fly-throughs as eye-catching promo footage for social media.

money_ideas.idea: Record and sell short cinematic clips of real live events (storms, flight paths, ship routes) as stock footage for news and social media.
Offer a hosted 'live tracking dashboard' version for logistics or insurance clients who want to watch their own fleets.

steal_this: Record short, narrated screen captures of real unfolding events on the globe and post them same-day as breaking-news B-roll for explainer channels.
